lede: Tee Guan Trading Co is a car workshop in Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub. Its own website lists car servicing, car repair, alignment and accident repairs.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention tyre changes, rotation and puncture repair at competitive rates, help with dead batteries, and car servicing.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, teeguan.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
good_to_know: Established in 1975, according to its website
